# Ananya Gupta – Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Ananya Gupta, a B.Tech CSE (AIML) student at SRMCEM, Lucknow (graduating 2028),
> passionate about Data Science, AI/ML and Web Development.

Built as a static site with Astro, React and Tailwind CSS. Sections: Home (intro, skills, technologies),
Projects and Contact (form powered by Formspree). Requires Node.js >= 20 and pnpm.

## Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ananyagupta0913-code): source code and projects
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ananya-gupta-a15200378/): professional profile
- [Live site](https://ananyagupta0913-code.github.io/portfolio/): deployed portfolio

## Skills

- Programming: Python, C
- Web: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Currently learning: Machine Learning
